skills.name: Inkwash
skills.summary: Basic Attack Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG. Heavy Attack Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG. Press Normal Attack within a certain period of time after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash Stage 4. Mid-air Attack Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG. Dodge Counter Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Heavy Attack.…

skills.name: Through the Groves
skills.summary: Press Resonance Skill to dash forward for a distance, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Echo Skill DMG. If Resonance Skill is cast upon being attacked by an enemy target, Qiuyuan becomes immune to this instance of DMG and stagnates nearby enemies, while gaining immunity to interruption during this Resonance Skill. Switching to other Resonators removes the Stagnation effect from enemies. Undaunted Wayfarer Hold Resonance Skill to dash forward for a distance at the cost of STA,…

skills.name: Sundering Strike
skills.summary: Deal Aero DMG to targets within range, considered as Echo Skill DMG. For every 1% of Qiuyuan's Crit. Rate over 50%, this skill increases the Crit. DMG of all nearby active Resonators in the team by 2% for 30s, up to 30%.

skills.name: Verdant Edge
skills.summary: Basic Attack - Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash When Qiuyuan reaches 200 points of Swordster's Soliloquy, his Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: Inkwash, which chains together up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing Aero DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. skills.name: Quietude Within
skills.summary: Qiuyuan obtains Quietude Within for 10s upon entering the Inksplash of Mind state. This effect can be triggered once every 22s. Heavy Attack Thus Spoke the Blade: To Teach, Thus Spoke the Blade: To Save, and Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice deal 50% more DMG. Thus Spoke the Blade: To Sacrifice additionally restores 30 points of Concerto Energy on hit. This effect ends early when Qiuyuan is switched off the field. skills.name: Drink Away Woes Age-Old
skills.summary: When casting Echo Skill, Qiuyuan's bamboo flask absorbs the overflowing energy and brews it into Flowing Panacea.

skills.name: Strike Before Ready
skills.summary: Attack the target, dealing Aero DMG equal to 100% of Qiuyuan's ATK, considered as Echo Skill DMG. Grant 50% Echo Skill DMG Amplification to the incoming Resonator, lasting for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.
